text_to_speech: hi my name's les Thomas of maximum win and I am the inventor of the tale of freedom seat I'll go ahead and demonstrate that I can sit on the stick so put the first anchor on one side that on the pole behind you I've already validated this pole put the other anchor on top of the first start to a lean forward into the hiking stick and then as you have tension in your straps you can fan out the seat around your buttocks and then once you feel comfortable you can start to put your legs out get a nice wide stance and rest comfortably [Music] and rest comfortably [Music]

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, my name's Les Thomas of Maximum Win and I'm the inventor of the Taylor Freedom Seat.
What I'll go ahead and demonstrate is that I can sit on the stick.
So put the first anchor on one side, that on the pole behind you.
I've already validated this pole, put the other anchor on top of the first.
Start to lean forward into the hiking stick.
And then as you have tension in your straps, you can fan out the seat around your buttocks.
And then once you feel comfortable, you can start to put your legs out and get a nice wide stance and rest comfortably.

youtube_description:
This video demonstrates how to use the TALO Freedom Seat with a single walking stick.

Available via Kickstarter now:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lesthomas/talo-freedom-seat?ref=apm24h

The TALO Freedom Seat is the pocket size hammock supported by your walking stick or trekking poles providing you a secure dry place to rest whenever needed.  

Great light weight tool to always have with you.  Made in the U.S.A. by Maximum Win LLC.
